```{r}
mv_fert <- load_multiverse("fertility")
mv_fert
```

# Overview

```{r}
mv_fert |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
vis_multiverse_tree(mv_fert)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_fert, direction = "right")
```

# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r}
reg_fert <- calc_regression(mv_fert, colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate")
reg_fert
```

```{r}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_fert)
```

## FANOVA

```{r}
fanova_fert <- calc_fanova(mv_fert, colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate")
fanova_fert
```

```{r}
fanova_fert |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

Only main effects

```{r}
fanova_fert |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

# Our Framework

```{r}
within_fert <- calc_within_bucket_variation(mv_fert, colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate")
within_fert
```

```{r}
vis_importance(within_fert)
```

```{r}
between_fert <- calc_between_bucket_variation(mv_fert, colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate")
between_fert
```

```{r}
vis_importance(between_fert)
```

# Decisions

For relationship_status options 1 and 2 we observe perfect overlap.

```{r}
mv_fert |> 
  vis_decision(
    mv_dim_relationship_status,
    type = "kde",
    colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"
  )
```
```{r}
mv_fert |> 
  vis_decision(
    mv_dim_relationship_status,
    type = "kde",
    facet = T,
    colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"
  )
```

```{r}
mv_fert |> 
  vis_decision(
    mv_dim_fertile,
    type = "kde",
    facet = T,
    colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"
  )
```


```{r}
mv_fert |> 
  vis_two_decisions(
    mv_dim_fertile,
    mv_dim_menstrual_calculation,
    facet = T,
    type = "kde",
    colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"
  )
```
